meta.title: What Marble Mountains Is REALLY Like | Da Nang, Vietnam
meta.description:
We visited Marble Mountains also known as Ngu Hanh Son in Da Nang, Vietnam to see what it was really like.

We’d seen the beautiful photos, read the reviews and watched plenty of videos before coming here, so we had a pretty good idea of what to expect. But once we actually visited, our experience was a little different from what we had seen online.

We're not trying to say Marble Mountains isn't worth visiting. It’s a beautiful place and we’re glad we went. But we wanted to show you our honest experience so you can get a better idea of what it's really like and decide for yourself.

If you're planning a trip to Da Nang, Vietnam, or looking for things to do in Da Nang, hopefully this video gives you a better idea of what to expect when visiting Marble Mountains.
